name: Suntouched
description:
When critically hit or taking more than 25% of your Health in a single blow, become Suntouched for 3s, reducing active cooldowns by 2s and Marking the enemy who triggered this effect.

While Suntouched, you cannot be critically hit or send another Mark

name: Ricochet
description:
Fire an arrow that ricochets off walls, dealing Physical Damage to enemies is passes through. Deals increasing Damage with each ricochet.

• Marked enemies who are hit are Stunned
• Ricochet bounces an additional time if you have 400 or more Intelligence

name: Mark of the Golden Crow
description:
Mark an enemy causing your other abilities to apply additional effects.

While STR is higher than INT, Marked enemies take bonus Physical Damage based on their missing health. While INT is higher than STR, Marked additional effects are amplified.

• Ricochet Stuns Marked enemies
• Divebomb Knocks Away Marked enemies
• Sunbreaker Slows Marked enemies more

name: Divebomb
description:
Leap into the air before selecting a location to dive onto, dealing Physical Damage to enemies where you land.

• Marked enemies who are hit are Knocked Away

name: Sunbreaker
description:
Shoot down 9 suns every 0.5s onto a target area, dealing Physical Damage and Slowed enemies hit. The first sun stays, acting as a wall that Ricochet can bounce off of.

• Marked enemies who are more heavily Slowed

name: Hou Yi Basic Attack
description: Fire a projectile that deals Physical Damage to the first enemy hit.
